excerpt: Reasons we may redact material include but are not limited to:

context_stem: Reasons we may redact material include but are not limited to:
excerpt: Legal compliance: To comply with legal obligations on disclosing information, such as export control regulations, national security restrictions, or contractual obligations with third parties.
paraphrase: Redaction may occur to comply with legal disclosure obligations such as export controls, national security restrictions, or third-party contracts.

context_stem: Reasons we may redact material include but are not limited to:
excerpt: Intellectual property protection: To protect proprietary information, including technical details of our models and training methodologies, trade secrets, or other confidential business information.
paraphrase: Redaction may occur to protect proprietary technical, methodological, or trade secret information.

context_stem: Reasons we may redact material include but are not limited to:
excerpt: Public safety considerations: To protect public safety by not disclosing information that could be exploited to cause harm.
paraphrase: Redaction may occur to prevent disclosure of information that could be exploited to cause harm.

context_stem: Reasons we may redact material include but are not limited to:
excerpt: Privacy: To protect the personal privacy of individuals.
paraphrase: Redaction may occur to protect individuals' personal privacy.

excerpt: We will work toward a practice of seeking comprehensive, public external review on our Risk Reports.
paraphrase: Anthropic will work toward comprehensive, public external review of its Risk Reports.

excerpt: This means working with one or more third-party organizations that will receive private versions of our Risk Reports (unredacted or with minimal redactions, as discussed below) and publish comprehensive commentary on them.
paraphrase: This involves third-party organizations receiving largely unredacted private versions of the reports and publishing comprehensive commentary.

excerpt: Commentary will address topics including the quality of our reasoning, the validity of our risk assessments, the overall level of risk, and whether the redactions we've made for the public version are reasonable and appropriate.
paraphrase: External commentary will cover reasoning quality, risk assessment validity, overall risk level, and reasonableness of redactions.

excerpt: Our intent is for external reviewers' judgments to carry significant weight in the eyes of the public as well as our employees.
paraphrase: The intent is that external reviewers' judgments will carry significant weight with both the public and employees.

excerpt: But there are no well-established organizations or procedures for this sort of practice, and we are approaching it as an experiment.
paraphrase: No well-established organizations or procedures exist for this practice, so it is being approached experimentally.

excerpt: At a minimum, we will complete a full external review process (described below) with at least one external reviewer anytime a Risk Report covers highly capable models and is significantly redacted, defined as follows:
paraphrase: A full external review with at least one reviewer will be completed whenever a Risk Report covers highly capable models and is significantly redacted.

excerpt: A model is "highly capable" if we conclude it could fully automate, or dramatically accelerate, the work of large, top-tier research teams in domains where fast progress could threaten international security or rapidly disrupt the global balance of power—for example, energy, robotics, weapons development, or AI itself.
paraphrase: A model is deemed highly capable if it could fully automate or dramatically accelerate top research teams' work in domains that could threaten international security or disrupt the global balance of power.

excerpt: For now, our evaluations will focus specifically on AI R&D: we will consider a model highly capable if we determine that it could compress two years of 2018 – 2024 AI progress into a single year.
paraphrase: Evaluations currently focus on AI R&D, treating a model as highly capable if it could compress two years of 2018-2024 AI progress into one year.
stated_bar: compress two years of 2018 – 2024 AI progress into a single year

excerpt: We hope to develop additional metrics for other domains over time. (The recommendations for industry-wide safety (see Section 1) provide additional context.)
paraphrase: Additional metrics for other domains are hoped to be developed over time, with further context in the industry-wide safety recommendations.

excerpt: "Significantly redacted" means that the redactions omit information a reasonable external safety researcher would consider important in evaluating the overall level of risk, such that a reader of only the public version could not meaningfully assess whether they agree with our conclusions.
paraphrase: Significantly redacted means omitting information that a reasonable external safety researcher would deem important, preventing meaningful assessment by public-version readers.
